title: Charge loss,control delivery and reset around the gate
statement: At illustrative Q390000 and5GHz the response maps T1 to12.4141microseconds. A hypothetical1.820microsecond readout would incur13.6367%loss under that scenario; a0.1%budget would require Q>=5.71e7. These are scenario calculations,not a universal device threshold. Common-mode cooling alone cannot reset the exactly separated dark register.
